ordered_stages.adapter_preparation_status: official source-hash-bound 262D-per-person preprocessing with coordinate-anchor choice kept distinct from final person order, deterministic eight-variant paired 524D VQ window dataset, paired 320/192/12 three-quantizer VQ full/encode/decode interface, exact one-token-triple-per-dyad MGT binding, term-by-term official InterMask per-person VQ-loss parity, hash-bound InterCLIP batch/alignment/metric wrapper, fixed val-only checkpoint-selection requests, true-length VQ reconstruction FID/R-Precision/MPJPE validation, hash-bound official InterMask VQ reconstruction exporter, gated deterministic online-W&B VQ training entrypoint, official-support MGT text/crop/anchor/order dataset with post-crop online VQ tokenization and exact step-resumable epoch/draw sampler, strict main/MM generated-H5 schemas, scorers and 20-rep aggregator complete; the real 300-frame paired VQ -> 75x3-token -> HHC Transformer forward path is covered, the unchanged common50 sampler has a tested official floor-length/decode/zero-pad bridge, and a real masked training objective backpropagates only into the Transformer. Paper versus historical tail-token semantics are explicit and tested rather than treating an online-VQ padding code as historical END. In-memory periodic MGT validation now reuses the frozen 480-sample official InterCLIP metric path and preserves RNG state, including a source-bound frozen val-only 100-prompt x 11-repeat MModality diagnostic. A strict manifest-bound loader reconstructs the selected HHC VQ and MGT for downstream export without guessing architecture. The gated MGT pilot is preregistered and has a real training entrypoint with the recovered 1024/16-head/7+2+9 topology, paper mask ratios, common50 validation, exact optimizer-step resume and mandatory online telemetry. Resume RNG restoration now occurs after CLIP/InterCLIP/W&B construction and DataLoaders use isolated generators, eliminating a previously hidden continuation-mask drift. It stops cleanly at the preregistered 50k decision point and can continue the identical run to 300k without reinitialization. Formal main and 100x30 MM H5 export is resumable, writes motion chunks durably before completion markers, is schema-compatible with the frozen scorers and uses an InterHuman-only per-sample uint64-seeded sampler proven invariant to batch grouping; the shared Inter-X sampler and builder remain on the original class. The finalizer first verifies that the supplied checkpoint is the immutable official-val-FID selection recorded by a completed training manifest, then runs all 20 main/MM replications and the strict aggregator. Training provenance includes the InterHuman subclass and model builder; every generated H5 also records the exact exporter and generation-bridge source hashes, and aggregation rejects source drift across replications. The request-local sampler is also bit-identical to the unchanged base sampler for a single request with the same seed.  Official-val main FID sampling now uses the same frozen per-request repeat-0 seed contract as formal export. Every training event carries an explicit optimizer-step axis, and formal evaluation is gated by a remote-finished online-W&B audit whose InterHuman-specific profile requires train loss/valid-masked-per-channel accuracy, gradients, weights, clipping, throughput and all val loss/FID/R-Precision/Matching/Diversity/MModality streams through 300k. The VQ schedule is now one immutable 30k cosine run with a clean 10k decision pause (rather than the previous contradictory 10k zero-LR endpoint); downstream MGT rejects pilot-only/non-selected VQs and requires a source-bound, remote-finished 30k InterHuman-VQ W&B audit. The InterHuman VQ/MGT W&B profiles are exact-name checked against every emitted required metric, including VQ optimizer throughput, so a typo cannot silently make the later remote audit impossible. The released InterMask VQ exporter now supports the frozen 480-sample official val set (without touching test), and a separate namespace-safe scorer uses the identical InterCLIP metric core plus MPJPE/feature error for the 10k VQ decision baseline. The selected full-endpoint HHC VQ also has an independent frozen-val rescorer and a request/evaluator-identical comparison card against the released InterMask VQ, with explicit metric directions and no test-set selection. A foreground-only VQ runner now enforces completed Inter-X shape acceptance, performs the clean 10k pause/30k same-run resume, and after full training automatically audits W&B, rescores selected HHC and released InterMask VQs, and builds the matched comparison without deleting or silently overwriting artifacts. A matching foreground-only MGT runner enforces the accepted Inter-X and completed/audited selected VQ prerequisites, supports 50k pilot, resume-pilot, same-run continuation to 300k, and resumable formal common50 finalization; the VQ runner also supports atomic pilot recovery after reboot. All 106 focused CPU/static contract tests pass. The VQ and MGT pilots remain deliberately unlaunched behind the Inter-X gate
